Description
Peking University HSBC Business School (PHBS) is a Graduate Business School of Peking University, one of the best universities in China and worldwide. Peking University is ranked 14th in the world by QS world university ranking 2026 and 4th in the world for Business and Economics by THE Subject ranking 2025.
The School is among the 1% of the business school worldwide to hold the “Triple Crown” accreditation from AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS, attesting to its commitment to outstanding business education.
As the most internationalized business school in China, the school currently offer Masters and PhD in Management, Finance, and Economics in English to international students.
The unique Cross-border programmes offer an unparalleled opportunity to study at both UK and China:
• Cross-Border Master in Finance
• Cross-Border Master in Management
Students benefit from a UK study experience in a student city, insight into both UK and Chinese economies, structured Mandarin course throughout the degree, and strong post-study career prospects in Mainland China, Hong Kong and the UK.
